{"rule_yaml": "
title: PowerShell Execution via Outlook
id: 4f2a1b3c-5d6e-7f8a-9b0c-1d2e3f4a5b6c
status: experimental
description: Detects PowerShell execution launched by Outlook with bypass and hidden window options, as observed in INC-2026-0417.
references:
    - Internal Incident INC-2026-0417
author: SOC Analyst N2
date: 2024/11/16
logsource:
    product: windows
    category: process_creation
detection:
    selection:
        ParentImage|endswith: '\OUTLOOK.EXE'
        Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
        CommandLine|contains: 
            - '-ExecutionPolicy Bypass'
            - '-WindowStyle Hidden'
    condition: selection
fields:
    - ComputerName
    - User
    - CommandLine
    - ParentImage
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate Outlook add-ins or automation scripts (rare with these specific flags)
level: high
tags:
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1059.001
"}

{"rule_text": "
rule PowerShell_AMSI_Bypass_Persistence {
    meta:
        description = "Detects PowerShell script with AMSI bypass and persistence capabilities observed in INC-2026-0417"
        author = "SOC Analyst N2"
        date = "2024-11-16"
        reference = "INC-2026-0417"
        mitre_attack = "T1685, T1547.001"

    strings:
        $amsi_bypass = "amsiInitFailed" nocase
        $amsi_ref = "System.Management.Automation.AmsiUtils" nocase
        $reg_run = "Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run" nocase
        $sched_task = "New-ScheduledTaskAction" nocase
        $hidden_win = "-WindowStyle Hidden" nocase

    condition:
        (all of ($amsi_bypass, $amsi_ref)) and (any of ($reg_run, $sched_task, $hidden_win))
}
"}

{"rule_text": "
rule PowerShell_AMSI_Bypass_Persistence {
    meta:
        description = "Detects PowerShell script with AMSI bypass and persistence capabilities observed in INC-2026-0417"
        author = "SOC Analyst N2"
        date = "2024-11-16"
        reference = "INC-2026-0417"
        mitre_attack = "T1685, T1547.001"

    strings:
        $amsi_bypass = "amsiInitFailed" nocase
        $amsi_ref = "AmsiUtils" nocase
        $reg_run = "CurrentVersion\\Run" nocase
        $sched_task = "New-ScheduledTaskAction" nocase
        $hidden_win = "WindowStyle Hidden" nocase

    condition:
        (all of ($amsi_bypass, $amsi_ref)) or (all of ($reg_run, $sched_task)) or (all of ($amsi_bypass, $hidden_win))
}
"}
